unmapped_labels: The narrative instructions and the 'THIS STATEMENT IS RELATIVE TO...' banner carry no fields.

Items 3, 4 and 7 are open free-text boxes with no printed writing rules inside them; the mapped x/y is the first text line and 'region' gives the box to wrap inside. Line count is an estimate from the box height, not from printed rules.
The form repeats items 1-8 conceptually 'for each such conviction' but provides only one set of blanks (except item 8, which has two rows); additional convictions need a continuation sheet.
'Date of Birth', item 1, item 2 and the signature date all use an unlabelled left cell edge - x=490 was inferred from the Mo/Day/Yr captions and the day-cell width, not from a printed rule.
